name: Tokeru Fuuka to Shirousagi
original_name: とける風花とシロうさぎ
source:
Minoru is a young man running a bar in a rundown shopping street in Iwate Prefecture.

One day, a mysterious girl with rabbit ears appears before him: Pooka.
Innocent, always eating, always laughing.

But she is a presence visible only to Minoru.

A strange shared life begins, out of nowhere.

The people who gather at the bar,
an everyday world that slowly expands,
and the reason the girl appeared.

This is a story of people who have lost something, learning to face forward again.

[Translated from [url=https://shiratamaco.com/kazeshiro/]official website[/url]]
